name: Sabores Vietnamese Beef Pho Rice Noodle Soup (No Lime/Jalapeño Mod)
whyItWorks: Clear aromatic beef bone broth with soft rice noodles and thin-sliced lean beef is hydrating, dairy-free, wheat-free, and gentle on an inflamed gut.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Beef Pho and skip the raw garnish plate (do not squeeze the lime wedge, and skip raw bean sprouts, sliced jalapeños, and sriracha).
watchOuts: Do NOT add the lime wedge (citrus trigger), raw bean sprouts (insoluble fiber), or sriracha/jalapeños
